author: Student Analyst
description: Unified forensic event schema designed for multi-source log normalization across Windows, Linux, and Network vectors.

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Standardized UTC ISO 8601 timestamp representing when the event occurred.
fields.justification: Provides chronological ordering across disparate host and network telemetry sources for timeline reconstruction.

source_mapping.linux_text: Normalized from syslog/audit timestamp_raw combined with pack_year

fields.name: hostname
fields.description: The distinct network or system identifier of the host generating the event.
fields.justification: Allows analysts to scope incidents to specific assets during containment and triage.

source_mapping.network_csv: Derived from packet metadata or set to 'network-sensor'

fields.name: source_type
fields.description: Internal pipeline category descriptor indicating the ingestion parser vector.
fields.justification: Enables downstream processors to apply parser-specific extraction rules safely.

fields.name: event_category
fields.description: Normalized functional grouping such as authentication, process, network, file, or system_audit.
fields.justification: Required by detection rules and triage filters to query actions independently of OS vendor terminology.

source_mapping.windows_json: Mapped via Channel/EventID lookup table (e.g., Security/4624 -> authentication)
source_mapping.linux_text: Mapped via program/audit_type lookup table (e.g., sshd -> authentication)

fields.name: severity
fields.description: Standardized risk severity rating (info, low, medium, high, critical).
fields.justification: Enables automated alert triage and prioritizing high-risk indicators during investigations.

source_mapping.windows_json: Mapped from EventID risk profiles (e.g., 4625 -> medium, Sysmon 1 -> info)
source_mapping.linux_text: Mapped from syslog level or audit failure codes

fields.name: user
fields.description: Primary user account associated with the execution context or event action.
fields.justification: Answers who performed the action to track compromised credentials or unauthorized access.

source_mapping.linux_text: Extracted user field or parsed via regex from auth log context

fields.name: process_name
fields.description: File name or full executable path of the process responsible for the event.
fields.justification: Critical for detecting living-off-the-land binaries and unauthorized execution chains.

fields.name: src_ip
fields.description: Originating IPv4 or IPv6 address for network connections or remote sessions.
fields.justification: Allows identification of external command and control nodes or internal lateral movement sources.

source_mapping.linux_text: Extracted via regex matching IP patterns in raw message

fields.name: dst_ip
fields.description: Target IPv4 or IPv6 destination address for network connections or traffic.
fields.justification: Required to detect data exfiltration paths or connections to known malicious infrastructure.

fields.name: raw_message
fields.description: The immutable raw string content or serialized log text of the original event.
fields.justification: Preserves absolute forensic fidelity and supports audit validation requirements.
